result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with mixed-use buildings and basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and traffic signals. However, the large crossing distance and lack of modern safety enhancements like curb extensions or high-visibility markings increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are not highly visible, which may lead to drivers failing to yield.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply continental-style markings to make the crossing more visible to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and a large pedestrian refuge island, but is complicated by a wide roadway and a right-turn slip lane. While sidewalks are in good condition, the overall design prioritizes vehicle throughput, creating long crossing distances for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Right-turn slip lane
hazards.description: A dedicated right-turn lane allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds when turning, increasing risk to pedestrians crossing to the refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection, separating the main roadway from the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb line may block the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sight lines for all road users.

interventions.title: Tighten Corner Radii
interventions.description: Redesign the slip lane or corner to force slower vehicle turning speeds.
